reasoning_content: Gradle is ready! Now let's build the APK.

action.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Build APK
c.exec_command("""export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64
export ANDROID_HOME=~/android-sdk
export PATH=/opt/gradle-8.5/bin:\$JAVA_HOME/bin:\$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:\$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools:\$PATH
cd /opt/areloria/client/android
/opt/gradle-8.5/bin/gradle assembleDebug 2>&1 | tail -30""")

print("Build started!")

c.close()
EOF
